NEOW.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.0-0: [jitter][orange]I'm here to kill the Architect. Could you give me a little more to help me out?[/orange][/jitter]
NEOW.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.1-1: [orange]That's exactly why I'm here. Can you give me something better to help me with that?[/orange]
NEOW.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.2-1: [orange]Do you happen to know if the Architect has any weaknesses? [i](sitting on a rock, roasting fish)[/i].[/orange]
NEOW.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.3-0: [orange]Let's see what it is this time.[/orange]
OROBAS.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.0: [rainbow freq=0.3 sat=0.8 val=1][sine]Magic?! So colourful! So pretty!![/sine][/rainbow]
[rainbow freq=0.3 sat=0.8 val=1][sine]Orobas! Can see!! Colourful all around!! Pretty!![/sine][/rainbow]
OROBAS.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.1: [rainbow freq=0.3 sat=0.8 val=1][sine]Magic?! So colourful! So pretty!![/sine][/rainbow]
[orange]Wanna learn? Give me something good and we'll trade?[/orange]
[rainbow freq=0.3 sat=0.8 val=1][sine]No!! Colourful! Pretty! Not fun! Shiny stuff for you! But must be fun!![/sine][/rainbow]
[orange]Then how about I tell you a story?[/orange]
OROBAS.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.2: [orange]I tell you a story, you give me something good?[/orange]
OROBAS.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.3: [rainbow freq=0.3 sat=0.8 val=1][sine]Really!? Tell it! Tell it now!![/sine][/rainbow]
DARV.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.0-0: [sine]Oh ho ho~[/sine] Little one, since you've met me here, you must be a more powerful wizard than you look. Come, take a look at my collection!
DARV.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.0-1: [orange]I've read about these things in books... Where did you find them all?[/orange]
DARV.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.1-0: [sine]Oh ho ho~[/sine] Little one, since you've met me here, you must be a more powerful wizard than you look. Come, take a look at my collection!
DARV.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.1-1: [orange]Perfect – I get to see these antiques up close.[/orange]
DARV.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.2-0: [orange]That one's nice – I'll take it again this time.[/orange]
DARV.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.2-1: A regular customer? I don't recall you at all.
DARV.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.3-0: [sine]Oh ho ho~[/sine] Little one, since you've met me here, you must be a more powerful wizard than you look. Come, take a look at my collection!
PAEL.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.0-0: [thinky_dots]......This scent... it's familiar... Have you met my soldiers?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.0-2: [thinky_dots]Or perhaps you saw me while I was asleep......[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.1-0: [thinky_dots]......This scent... it's familiar... Have you met my soldiers?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.2-0: [thinky_dots]......This scent... it's familiar... You... no, even our conversation feels familiar......[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.3-0: ......If this endless journey wears you out, you may rest here with me for a while......
TEZCATARA.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZAR: [sine]Oh~ what a cute little one! Just like a miniature me![/sine]
[sine]Come in, come in – you must be hungry![/sine]
[sine]Oh~ what a cute little one! Just like a miniature me![/sine]
[sine]Little ones need to eat plenty to grow tall![/sine]
[sine]No problem – shall I sing you a lullaby?[/sine]
[sine]Oh~ what a cute little one! Just like a miniature...[/sine]
[orange]Do you have a way to kill the Architect?[/orange]
[sine]......Oh ho ho... That's quite a statement. I'm sorry, I don't know, but I'll do my best to help you![/sine][i](Tezcatara chuckles happily.)[/i]
[sine]Little cutie. Let me burn away your flaws![/sine]
VAKUU.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.0-: [sine]Oh my, if it isn't the great archmage? A rare guest.[/sine]
[sine]Wait, don't be angry. How about I make it up to you with these fine goods?[/sine]
[jitter][orange]You think I'm not angry enough already?[/orange][/jitter]

[sine]Just kidding. [i][red](Vakuu conjures a contract and points to a line of nearly illegible text.)[/red][/i] But look here – you must accept my [red]"gift"[/red] – [jitter][red]you have no choice.[/red][/jitter][/sine]
VAKUU.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.1-: [orange][jitter]I should consider letting the Architect chop your head off again.[/jitter][/orange]
[sine]Ha! You're not bad at cracking jokes yourself.[/sine]
VAKUU.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.2-: [sine]Still not giving up? This is the [red]3rd[/red] time.[/sine]
[orange]After all these loops, I've prepared a big gift for you too.[/orange]
[sine][red](barely alive.)[/red] Haha...... You think that would work...... You'll see me again......[/sine]
VAKUU.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.3-: [sine]I told you it's useless. And besides, you've accumulated all that magic over so many loops – why not use it for a [red]trade[/red] instead?[/sine]
[orange]That's what I thought at first, but after seeing your ugly mug one too many times, I changed my mind.[/orange]
[sine]Then I guess you'll have to accumulate another round.[/sine]
TANX.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.0-0: [b]You! Little thing! I see you, [jitter][red]fight me!![/red][/jitter][/b]
TANX.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.0-2: [red][jitter][b]Drop that lousy stick and take up a longsword – fight me!![/b][/jitter][/red]
TANX.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.2-0: [b][jitter]That little thing with a face on its hat, [red]stop hiding – I see you! Come fight me!![/red][/jitter][/b]
TANX.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZARD.2-2: [b][jitter][red]Hahahaha! A very novel way to fight!! This is your reward! Take it![/red][/jitter][/b]
NONUPEIPE.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_WIZAR: Your outfit is far too shabby. I grant you a [purple]gorgeous robe[/purple] – you just need to do me a small favour.
[orange]Killing the Architect with just that isn't enough.[/orange]
Your outfit is far too shabby. I grant you a [purple]gorgeous robe[/purple] – you just need to [sine]......[/sine]
[orange]I'd like to try that one this time.[/orange]
[orange][i](points at something being held by a servant)[/i].[/orange]
[sine]Hmph[/sine], not shy at all. Do you have a [blue]reason[/blue] to convince me?
[orange]I'm here to [jitter][red]kill the Architect[/red][/jitter] – is that reason enough?[/orange]
[sine]Hmm~[/sine] Well then, that makes it easy.
[orange]I'm here to [jitter][red]kill the Architect[/red][/jitter] – give me something good.[/orange]
[sine]Such bold words. Put on my power and [red]destroy the Architect.[/red][/sine]
Your outfit is far too shabby. I grant you a [purple]gorgeous robe[/purple] – you just need to do me a small favour.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.LITTLEWIZARD-LITTLE_W: [sine]Not only do you never experience the moment of [red]world destruction[/red], but you've also been granted [blue]immortality[/blue] – so why do you want to end this [red]"gift"[/red]?[/sine]
[orange]Because it gets a bit boring. Every so often I see a new batch of people come to you – you must be tired of it too.[/orange]
[sine]......If you weren't here to bother me, we might actually have [blue]common ground[/blue]. ......Do you have anything to say?[/sine]
[sine]Do you think I would tell you?[/sine]
[orange]Anyway, if I die I'll just come back – [sine]why not ask?[/sine][/orange]
[sine]Have you thought of any other way to break this [red]curse[/red]?[/sine]
[orange][jitter](casting freezing ray)[/jitter] I tried that method – it didn't work. So now I have to try it on you too.[/orange]
[sine]If you want to break the [red]curse[/red] of reincarnation, why not go see [red]Vakuu[/red]?[/sine]
[orange]There are curses that don't break even when the caster dies – you have to fulfil a condition. Haven't you ever seen one?[/orange]
[jitter][orange]No more words – let's get to it.[/jitter][/orange]
